purpose: Broaden Stage 0 Aseprite/LibreSprite chunk coverage beyond the linked-cel subset by proving Tilemap Layer type 2, Tileset Chunk 0x2023, and compressed Tilemap Cel Chunk 0x2005 type 3 parsing in a deterministic semantic-organ tile ID carrier, without claiming arbitrary schema or live external editor coverage.

external_anchors.used_for: ASE Layer Chunk 0x2004 tilemap layer type 2, Cel Chunk 0x2005 compressed tilemap cel type 3 layout, Tileset Chunk 0x2023 layout, and tile bitmask semantics.
Tilemap remains a tile editing workflow boundary; semantic restore is still governed by Mechagotchi metadata.
LibreSprite remains a compatibility boundary; no GPL editor code is embedded.

limitations: Stage 0 Aseprite/LibreSprite tilemap proof covers one Tilemap Layer type 2, one embedded Tileset Chunk 0x2023, and compressed Tilemap Cel Chunk 0x2005 type 3 payloads.
Tile IDs encode empty/core/sensors/expression organ occupancy only; visual and full semantic restore still comes from the embedded sidecar.
Live external editor rewrite validation is not verified by this lab.
